name: program_modulation_validation
status: prospective for the next real-data run; software design informed by synthetic counterexamples, not independent registration
reason: A generic perturbation response confined to one axis passes the historical quantitative gates, and absent marker overlap selects feature -1. Neither behavior establishes perturbation-identity specificity.
primary_scope: Conditional cell-level perturbation-identity rank heterogeneity for externally named, control-selected programs. A rejection is not pathway specificity, biological replication, an SAE advantage, or novelty.

input.preparation: src/prep_norman.py; retain integer counts; record downloaded-file hash without claiming it is an independent expected checksum
input.duplicate_symbols: fail before training if duplicate symbols survive the gene panel; document an explicit aggregation/mapping policy in a separate amendment before resolving them
input.programs: All nine config/human_markers.json marker_sets; retain unmatchable programs with p=1

training.sensitivity_train_on: control; report as sensitivity, not a gate or validated replacement
training.small_cpu_runs: Implementation pilots only; they do not complete this full-data analysis

marker_match.selection: control cells only; eligible features active in at least 50 controls; top 50 associated genes
marker_match.no_match: Do not score an arbitrary feature; retain the named hypothesis with p=1
marker_match.interpretation: A diagnostic annotation gate; gene correlations violate a naive exchangeable-gene interpretation of hypergeometric p

identity_inference.statistic: Sum over eligible single-perturbation groups of n_g times squared deviation of pooled mean midrank from the grand mean
identity_inference.empirical_p: (1 + number of permuted statistics >= observed) / (1 + number of permutations)
identity_inference.conditioning: Keep original controls, eligible groups, chosen features and fitted label-blind representation fixed; shuffle only single-perturbation identities
identity_inference.strata: Use documented exchangeable batch/guide/replicate strata where appropriate. A completely confounded design is uninformative and receives p=1. Cell shuffling does not create biological replicates.
identity_inference.multiplicity_per_seed: Holm across all nine planned programs, including no-match p=1
identity_inference.across_seeds: Report all 27 raw program-by-seed p-values and apply Holm across that complete family before inferential claims about repeated seed findings. Agreement across seeds is computational robustness, not independent biological replication.
identity_inference.limitations: Unequal generic perturbation severity can cause rank heterogeneity. Exchangeability must be justified from the experimental design. Inspecting the data and choosing strata or signatures afterward makes those analyses exploratory.

historical_readouts.full_label_shuffle: Exploratory only: it does not repeat the control-dependent feature selection; no calibrated discovery claim
historical_readouts.random_feature_percentile: Descriptive; feature activity/power are unmatched and the selected named feature is not exchangeable with random features
historical_readouts.per_perturbation_modulators: Exploratory candidates; BH within one program does not correct the full program-by-perturbation family

follow_up_required_before_biological_cla: Direct external-marker expression-score baseline with held-out controls and target-transcript omission sensitivity
Guide, batch, library-depth, cell-state and generic-effect severity checks supported by available experimental metadata
Appropriate full-family multiple-testing correction for named regulator claims
Primary-literature review and independent validation for any proposed mechanism or novelty
Direct PCA/NMF feature baselines if an SAE advantage is claimed; PCA/NMF-to-SAE inputs are not those baselines
archive: Retain code and data hashes, resolved versions, complete arguments, seed, training population, strata, all named-program records, null metadata, logs and per-perturbation outputs. Preserve prior outputs; use a new output path for every run.
